exposure: Standard cesarean section uterine closure (single-layered running lock sutures)
K uterine closure technique (primary horizontal mattress sutures)
outcome: Pre- and post-operative hemoglobin and hematocrit levels
Length of total and postoperative hospital stay
cohort: 613 patients undergoing elective primary and repeat cesarean section
finding: The K uterine closure technique is a safe and effective alternative to single-layered lock sutures for cesarean section, resulting in decreased hospital stay but increased operation time.
mod_finding: The K uterine closure technique is a safe and effective alternative to single-layered lock sutures for cesarean section closure.
